description:
The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC) Command, Control, Communications 
and Battle Management (C3BM) Operating Location 2 (OL-2) is executing Software 
Development Lifecyle Management for Air Mobility Command’s (AMC) Rapid Global Mobility 
Command and Control (RGM C2) Program, that leverages technical solutions and practices for 
all Air Force Transportation (AFTRANS) operations. AMC is the air component of United States 
Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM), providing air refueling, cargo, and personnel 
delivery globally. AMC is also the Air Force Lead Command and Core Function Lead for RGM 
C2. To effectively support the Joint Force, the MAF must globally command, control, and 
collaborate, navigate in degraded or operationally limited environments, conduct enroute logistics 
while under attack, and operate at the highest required tempo. This requires global situational 
awareness through collaboration, coordinated operations, and adherence to processes that 
accomplish Combatant Commander objectives.
